description: This file implements a Bluetooth plugin for a media framework, managing Bluetooth device discovery, connection, pairing, and events via BTRMGR API calls. It provides methods for scanning, connecting, retrieving device info, media info, and handling various Bluetooth events, wrapping lower-level Bluetooth manager functions.

classes.name: Bluetooth
classes.description: Main class implementing Bluetooth plugin API, managing Bluetooth devices and events via BTRMGR, exposing JSON RPC methods, handling device discovery, connection, pairing, media info, and event notifications.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number.

methods.name: startScanWrapper
methods.description: Initiates Bluetooth device discovery with optional timeout.

methods.name: stopScanWrapper
methods.description: Stops ongoing Bluetooth device discovery.

methods.name: isDiscoverable
methods.description: Checks if the Bluetooth adapter is discoverable.

methods.name: getDiscoveredDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of discovered Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: getPairedDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of paired Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: getConnectedDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a Bluetooth device.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from a Bluetooth device.

methods.name: setAudioStream
methods.description: Sets the audio stream focusing on the specified device.

methods.name: pair
methods.description: Presents pairing with a specified device.

methods.name: unpair
methods.description: Removes pairing with a specified device.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the Bluetooth adapter.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the Bluetooth adapter.

methods.name: setDiscoverable
methods.description: Sets the Bluetooth adapter's discoverability status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves Bluetooth adapter name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets Bluetooth adapter name.

methods.name: sendAudioPlaybackCommand
methods.description: Sends playback control commands to devices.

methods.name: respondToEvent
methods.description: Responds to pairing or connection requests.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for a specific device.

methods.name: getMediaTrackInfo
methods.description: Retrieves current media track info for a device.

methods.name: notifyEventWrapper
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth events received from the lower layer, converting them to JSON notification messages.
